upright.text_en: Dark young man, faithful, a lover, an envoy, a postman. Beside a man, he will bear favourable testimony concerning him. A dangerous rival, if followed by the Page of Cups. Has the chief qualities of his suit. He may signify family intelligence.

reversed.text_en: Anecdotes, announcements, evil news. Also indecision and the instability which accompanies it.

additional_upright.text_en: Young man of family in search of young lady.
